name: Seedream 5 Pro
description: A highly performant image model with robust editing capabilities. It allows users to sketch interfaces, draw bounding boxes, and provide detailed annotations to guide precise structural edits.
keyFeatures: Natively generates and breaks down transparent image layers
Strong multilingual text rendering for graphic design and posters
Translates rough user sketches into finalized UI designs
curatorNotes: Transcribed as "Cream 5 Pro" but matches the Seedream chapter. Hosted on ByteDance's DreamLau platform.
